title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes Deserves an Official English Release
content: Super Dragon Ball Heroes released in the summer of 2018 and ran through August of 2024, and yet, it remains the only full series in the franchise to not get an official English release. In fairness to Toei Animation, it is a non-canon promotional anime, so it’s not even a requirement for the official timeline.
author: ComicBook

title: Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ Manga Ends
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app published the second and last part of the final chapter of Jun Esaka and artist Kine Usuto 's Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ (I Want to Quit! ~I'll Reset for You~) manga on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai no Kū Anime Gets Light Novel
content: The story is set in the Genji era, when the Battle Spirits card game takes the city of Edo by storm. The game uses two cards: Eternal Cards, which only samurai are permitted to use, and Standard Cards, which anyone can use. The 11-year-old Kū Bashin encounters a mysterious card and begins his journey.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Will Reveal More of Korra’s Fate in Season 2
content: Avatar: Seven Havens began to scratch the surface of what led Korra to destroying the world with the cataclysm, and one of the producers behind the series has confirmed that fans will see more of Korra and what led to this post-apocalyptic event in the second season.
author: ComicBook

title: HIDIVE Streams Giant Ojosama TV Anime This Winter; Screens N. American Premiere at Anime Frontier on December 4
content: HIDIVE announced on Tuesday that it will stream the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga for the winter 2027 season in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: ANN

title: One Year Later, My Dress-Up Darling Still Leaves Fans Hanging With No Season 3
content: My Dress-Up Darling wrapped up its second season with an ending that seemed like it was ending the anime overall, and a little over a year later fans have still been left hanging with their hopes of a potential third season ever happening.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump Creator Breaks Silence on Ending Their Series After 5 Years & Teases Epilogue
content: A major Shonen Jump series has come to an end after five years with its final chapter released this past weekend, and the creator behind it all has broken their silence on the grand finale with a tease of some new materials for after the series came to an end.
author: ComicBook

title: The Game Awards 2026 Reveals Nominees
content: The Game Awards announced its list of 2026 nominees on Tuesday. The nominees for Game of the Year include Nintendo 's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and CAPCOM 's Resident Evil Requiem game.
author: ANN

title: New Boruto Preview Teases Disappointing Shift Away From a Major Fight
content: The new chapter of Boruto: Two Blue Vortex , Chapter 39, is just around the corner, and as the series usually does, it has released previews for the upcoming chapter. It was highly expected that the chapter would pick up on the major fight it had set up, with Boruto and Sarada joining forces against Code and Hidari.
author: ComicBook

title: Exclusive: Giant Ojosama Joins HIDIVE Winter 2027 Lineup, Anime Frontier Premiere Set for December 4
content: HIDIVE has acquired Giant Ojosama for its Winter 2027 simulcast lineup, with the comedy anime set to stream exclusively on the service beginning in January 2027. The series will be available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: Anime Corner
